dateOfOffense.description: Date when the defendant performed the prohibited activity (typically driving a motor vehicle). If the judgment describes the prohibited activity on several distinct dates, annotate each date separately.

timeOfOffense.description: Time when the defendant performed the prohibited activity. May contain a specific time or a time range.
timeOfOffense.format: HH:MM–HH:MM or HH:MM (24-hour time, ranges with optional 'from/to' text stripped)

placeOfOffense.description: Location where the prohibited activity was performed or where the defendant was stopped and checked. Includes information about the type of road, municipality, city, district, or other relevant location details, if available.

vehicleType.description: Type of vehicle operated by the defendant during the prohibited activity (e.g., passenger car, van/truck, bus, motorcycle, agricultural vehicle, other).

categories.van_truck: Van, light commercial vehicle, truck, or heavy goods vehicle
categories.agricultural_vehicle: Agricultural vehicle, including tractor or similar farm vehicle

reasonForCheck.description: Reason for the traffic stop or police control, if stated in the judgment (e.g., speeding, traffic violation, routine inspection, report from another person, accident, not specified).

categories.traffic_accident: Check initiated due to a traffic accident

additionalTrafficViolations.description: Any additional traffic offenses or violations committed in connection with the prohibited activity, excluding the core offense of driving despite the driving ban or prohibition itself. Examples include driving under the influence, causing an accident, speeding, failure to comply with traffic rules, or other related misconduct.

categories.no_driving_license: Driving without being a holder of a valid driving license
categories.no_documents: Driving without required vehicle or personal documents (license, registration, etc.)
categories.drunk_driving: Driving under the influence of alcohol or other addictive substances
categories.refusal_of_intoxication_test: Refusing to undergo a breath, blood, or other test for alcohol or other addictive substances
categories.traffic_sign_violation: Disregarding traffic signs or road markings (e.g., stop sign, wrong way, solid line)
categories.vehicle_technical_issue: Vehicle without valid technical/emission inspection or with technical faults
categories.lights_violation: Driving with improper or missing vehicle lighting
categories.failure_to_stop_for_authorities: Not stopping or trying to escape when ordered by police/customs
categories.other_traffic_offense: Other or unspecified traffic infractions or administrative offenses

issuingAuthority.description: Name of the authority that issued the decision

decisionIssueDate.description: Date on which the decision imposing the driving ban or prohibition was issued by the authority. Multiple values per sentence are allowed; the final dataset will include every value.

decisionEffectiveDate.description: Date on which the decision imposing the driving ban or prohibition became legally effective or entered into force. Multiple values per sentence are allowed; the final dataset will include every value.

drivingBanDuration.description: Duration of the imposed driving ban or prohibition. May be expressed as a period of time or as an end date until which the prohibition applies. Multiple values per sentence are allowed; the final dataset will include every value.

decisionReferenceNumber.description: Reference number of the decision imposing the driving ban or prohibition, including case number, file number, registration number, or other official identifier.

vehicleMakeAndModel.description: Brand and specific model of the vehicle involved (e.g., Škoda Superb, Škoda Octavia, Hyundai i20, VW Golf, Seat Inca, Mitsubishi Colt).

vehicleLicensePlate.description: Full or partially anonymized registration / license plate number of the vehicle (e.g., Q.-XXXEU, T.-XXXBC, PP419EE, HC-XXX-AL, I.-XXXEP).

vehicleColor.description: Color or color description of the vehicle (e.g., grey dark metallic, silver).

categories.white: White colored vehicle, including white metallic
categories.black: Black colored vehicle, including black metallic
categories.silver: Silver/grey colored vehicle, including silver metallic
categories.blue: Blue colored vehicle, including blue metallic
categories.red: Red colored vehicle, including dark red and red metallic
categories.green: Green colored vehicle, including dark green and green metallic
categories.brown: Brown colored vehicle, including brown metallic
categories.other: Vehicle color that does not fit standard basic color categories

policeUnitType.description: Type or designation of the police unit conducting the stop or control (e.g., district police department, traffic inspectorate, emergency motorized unit). If the control was conducted by municipal/city police, customs officers, or another non-Police Force authority, use other_police_unit unless a more specific Police Force unit from the listed categories is also named.

categories.district_police_department: Obvodné oddelenie PZ (district police department units, incl. motorized patrols from these units)
categories.traffic_police_department: Okresný/Krajský dopravný inšpektorát and related traffic inspectorate units
categories.emergency_motorized_unit: Pohotovostná motorizovaná jednotka (PMJ) and its patrols
categories.police_headquarters_special_unit: Prezídium PZ and other special/control units under HQ (e.g. special traffic control)
categories.generic_police_patrol: Unspecified police patrol or generic police unit reference
categories.other_police_unit: Other or composite/unclear police units not fitting the above, including municipal/city police, customs officers, or other non-Police Force authorities

policeUnitLocation.description: Geographical location of the police unit or department (e.g., Obvodné oddelenie PZ Piešťany, Dunajská Streda, Pov. Bystrica, Levoča, Veľký Krtíš, Trenčín, Šaštín-Stráže).
policeUnitLocation.format: [municipality or district name in canonical nominative form]
